title: Failure Summary Breadcrumb — lightweight summary + navigation for failed requests
creator: Priya Singh
description: Introduce a compact, left-aligned breadcrumb UI to appear at the top of a failed-request detail pane. The breadcrumb summarizes the failure at-a-glance (primary error class, retry state, latency bucket, and a one-line failure hint) and provides one-click navigation targets: timeline, payload inspector, retry log, and rollback controls. Goal: reduce time-to-first-action during triage by surfacing the minimal signal and direct pathways to deeper tools without forcing users to scan large panels or open multiple sidebars.
design_decisions: Show taxonomy chip (error-class) first because it best signals cause to SRE/engineers.
Compact retry chip shows count and most-recent-result; clicking opens expanded retry log rather than replacing the panel.
Keep breadcrumb persistent when scrolling to maintain quick navigation during deep payload inspection.
Mask sensitive payload fields by default; add a reveal action tied to role-based permissions to comply with PII policies.
tradeoffs: Inline breadcrumb reduces clicks but increases top-bar real estate; we opted for a single-line compact layout to minimize vertical noise.
Synchronous lookups for derived signals (e.g., inferred root-cause tag) are useful but could add latency to pane open; we fallback to client-side cached inference with server refresh for accuracy.
Showing minimal hint (one-line) risks being vague; link targets must be clearly labelled to avoid false signals.
accessibility_notes: Ensure breadcrumb is keyboard focusable and each chip is reachable via TAB with clear aria-labels (e.g., 'Open payload inspector for request 12345').
Contrast checks for chips and separators to meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
Provide screen-reader summary for expanded context that reads 'Failure summary: {error-class}, {retry-count} retries, {latency-bucket} latency'.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Breadcrumb renders for all failed requests in detail view and persists while scrolling.
AC-2: Clicking 'Payload' opens the payload inspector and anchors to the matching payload entry within 300ms (95th percentile within dataset).
AC-3: Retry chip accurately shows retry count and most recent retry state; clicking opens full retry log panel.
AC-4: PII fields remain masked by default; users with 'debugger:reveal-pii' role can unmask after explicit confirmation.
AC-5: Figma prototype has developer-ready specs (spacing, colors, token names) and is approved by engineering and PM.
